limitations: Small-case algorithm checks only; no online judge submissions, extreme-scale timing, or NTT implementation verification.

A.method: all targets in random binary trees; subtree distance equivalence and query limit

B.method: closed-walk state-space search including disconnected graphs and self loops

C.method: all length-4/6 permutation graphs, all balanced length-8 patterns and larger random permutations; simulate operations and enforce 114 limit

D.method: enumerate all ternary masks and all matching binary indices

E.method: incremental near-string tree against all pairwise Hamming distances

F.method: exhaustive coordinate grid 0..4; envelope conditions and all degeneracies versus segment intersection

G.method: enumerate all set partitions versus masked linear basis

H.method: exact minimax for every multiset of 2,4,6 values in 0..4

I.method: 150 exhaustive modification cases plus 150 full six-bit arrays against quadratic DP

J.method: enumerate all walks up to k edges, preserving duplicate edges, against lazy trie

K.method: block split points and lazy-add sum identities versus prefix scans

L.method: distinct reachable permutations from all recursive splits and extremal swaps versus 12-state DP

M.method: all binary strings through length 9; enumerate ordered trees and edge orientations versus matching polynomial
